newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ROCKFALL UNLIKELY TO AFFECT MUFULIRA OUTPUT - ZCCM.
newsitem.headline: ROCKFALL UNLIKELY TO AFFECT MUFULIRA OUTPUT - ZCCM.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines(ZCCM) said on Thursday production was unlikely to be affected at its Mufulira copper mine after a rockfall on Monday which killed two miners.
"Production is unlikely to be affected," a ZCCM official told Reuters.
Earlier ZCCM's Francis Musonda said in a statement there had been "no interruption of other mining operations" after the rockfall which occurred at 900 metres underground.
Five other miners were injured in the incident.
"The rockfall was as a result of a seismic event which happened without prior warning," Musonda said.
The mine produced around 52,000 tonnes of copper in concentrate in 1995-96.
